notes.title: Update for April 16, 2023 -- AutoSave -- v0.013
notes.content:
[h1]Patch v0.013 Notes[/h1]

[h2]AutoSave[/h2]

Introducing AutoSave!

This will autosave a new file every day and rewrite any current day file. Actions that will trigger an auto save are:
[list]
[*] Catching a new Kanji
[*] Leaving a Boss Battle
[*] Leaving an On/Kun Training
[*] Leveling a Kanji at the Kanji Leveler
[*] Leaving the Kanji Combine screen
[/list]

We still recommend manual saving for those who wish to play multiple playthroughs (multiple people per account).

For any improvements, bug disclosures, or general discussion - please join us on Discord!

notes.title: Update for April 15, 2023 -- Sakura Battle Mode -- v0.012
notes.content:
[h2]Patch v0.012 Notes[/h2]

[h3]Sakura Battle Mode[/h3]
Introducing a new learning centered battle mode for dungeons. Players will now have 5 chances to increase power of skill by up to 5x. Guessing a round of kanji correctly will move to the next until all 5 are completed. 

[h3]Fixes to Sakura Kanji Ketchi[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Kanji "Run Away" button
[*] Fixed issue where players would save and then open menu to blank menu with no option to exit
[*] Fixed broken fade system
[/list]

To give your feedback as well as report any bugs, please join us on discord by scanning the QR code on the main screen.
